A '''macrolaser tracker''' was a device within an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] which could be used to estimate the potential destinations of another moving vehicle. The tracker had to be aimed at the other vehicle, following which the airspeeders [[Computer/Legends|computer]] would take several [[Standard second|seconds]] to process before providing its destination coordinates. The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] used a macrolaser tracker to check if a [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transport]] was following his airspeeder on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Radnor/Legends|Radnor]], changing his own coordinates to see if the [[Transport/Legends|transports]] would change, which they did.<ref name="TWotA" />

==Behind the scenes==
A macrolaser tracker first appeared in ''[[Jedi Quest: The Way of the Apprentice]]'', a novel written by [[Jude Watson]] and released in [[2002]].
